worldcombat.skill.healorder.summary: Summons a swarm of retainers that channel around the caster; when the channel ends each survivor pays back a share of the healing. A retainer killed during the channel pays nothing, so the total depends on how many survive. With all survivors it restores about half of maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.healorder.use.1: Stretch healing into a window with killable retainers
worldcombat.skill.healorder.use.2: Heal as a group between blows
Summons %2$s retainers to channel; if all survive the caster regains %1$s of maximum health, and each retainer lost pays one share less.
They channel for %1$s, orbiting at %2$s blocks with %3$s health each, and can be attacked throughout.
worldcombat.skill.healorder.stance.elite: Elite retainers: half the count but tougher, so a single death costs a bigger share; for a caster that fears being wiped at once.
worldcombat.skill.healorder.stance.swarm: Swarm retainers: more numerous and fragile, so losing one or two costs little, but area damage shaves the total faster.
worldcombat.skill.healorder.timing: A self move; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.healorder.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.healorder.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.healorder.preference.e: On: half the retainers but 10 health each, so one death costs a bigger share. Off: more retainers with 4 health each, so losing one or two costs little.
worldcombat.skill.healorder.preference.a: Below this health ratio the companion summons retainers; lower endures longer, higher calls them at the first wound.
